Send newsletter via Mailchimp: 'Out now: [Track Name]' with Spotify link
Post on Facebook with Spotify link and album art
Post in r/progmetal and r/progrockmusic (check self-promotion rules first)
Share to relevant Discord servers and forums (ProgArchives, etc.)
Instagram Story #2: behind-the-scenes of the track (writing process, studio clip)
DAY 2: Check Spotify for Artists -- monitor saves, streams, skip rate, playlist adds
DAY 2: Post thank-you Story or share a streaming milestone
